contract.action_semantics: Rz(fixed yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll); board-local U/V; gap is world-Z clearance above nominal sphere/top-face contact plane

ball_to_tool.status: provisional ball center at simulated gripper TCP; uncalibrated

coordinates.height_definition: h_m = (release ball-center world Z - nominal first finite-board-contact ball-center world Z)/1000
coordinates.uv_definition: board-local top-face U/V in mm; not world XY

distribution.fixed_fields: all assets/contact parameters, bucket floor/geometry, board yaw, arm bases and tools
distribution.scope: narrow synthetic upright-bucket layouts; no physical or out-of-distribution claim

contract.domain_randomization: layout and release noise only; contact parameters are fixed provisional assumptions
contract.height_semantics: release_coordinates separately records finite-board first-contact h_m; gap need not equal h_m near edges

layout_feasibility: layouts are geometric-valid; each proposed action gets independent endpoint IK
